# Kiover — Portfolio & Software Engineering Profile
> Full-Stack, Desktop (C# / C++) & Mobile Developer | Bot Architecture & E-Commerce Specialist

Welcome to the LLM-readable interface for Kiover's professional developer portfolio.

## Developer Overview
- **Name:** Kiover
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/safadaooofc

- **Location:** Brazil

## Core Specializations
1. **Desktop Software & System Tools (PC):**
   - Languages: C# (.NET, WinForms, WPF), C++
   - Native Windows desktop applications, high-performance local utilities, automated data processors.

2. **Mobile App Development:**
   - Multiplatform mobile applications (Android & iOS) with fluid UI/UX and REST API integration.

3. **E-Commerce & Payment Gateways:**
   - Next.js 15/16 App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4.
   - Transparent checkouts, Instant PIX integration (AbacatePay, Mercado Pago, Stripe), dynamic geocoding freight calculations (Nominatim API), and custom product configurators.

4. **Discord Bots & Serverless Automations:**
   - discord.js v14, discord.py with Cogs, Discord Interactions REST endpoints, real-time database synchronization with PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, and Supabase.

5. **Roblox Luau & Game Systems:**
   - Large-scale roleplay and military game systems, real-time telemetry pipelines to Discord via Express API, 60 FPS mobile optimization, and persistent database architectures.

## Open Pro-Bono / Free Projects Policy
Kiover is currently accepting small custom software projects for free (custom Discord bots, landing pages, small websites, PC desktop tools in C#/C++, or mobile apps) to assist communities, build long-term partnerships, and expand the developer portfolio. Contact via Discord (`kiover`) or email (`paoteste40@gmail.com`).

## Key Portfolio Projects
- **BloodStore (https://github.com/xsag7/bloodstore3):** Full-stack digital e-commerce with Supabase, Netlify Functions & PostgreSQL. Built from scratch and successfully sold to client @xsag7.
- **Sagaz Site (https://github.com/safadaooofc/sagaz-site):** Next.js 16 digital products store with instant PIX webhook reconciliation and discord.js v14 bot synchronization on PostgreSQL.
- **Luxury Sales (https://github.com/safadaooofc/luxury-sales-site):** Next.js 15 digital games store with dual auth (Credentials + Discord OAuth), rate limiting, and admin analytics dashboard.
- **Alma Criativa Confeitaria (https://almacriativa.netlify.app):** Full-stack React 19 e-commerce with multi-layer product configurators, Mercado Pago checkout, and geocoded delivery rate engine.
- **LP Community (https://github.com/safadaooofc/lp-community):** High-converting GTA V store with real-time dynamic GTA$ calculator and WhatsApp/Discord smart checkout.
- **Reuel Site & CMS (https://github.com/safadaooofc/Site_regras_wl):** Institutional portal and live CMS with Discord OAuth2, REST slash commands, and player count proxy.
- **Capital do Mato Grosso Roleplay & EB Reuel:** Complex Roblox Luau game systems with database persistence, heist mechanics, and police dispatch.
- **Caixa de Comandos:** Python 3.10+ modular Discord bot built with Cogs and JSON webhook integration.
